description: Run compliance/suitability guardrails over a financing scenario and an optional recommendation. Returns flags (red/yellow with code + message) for things like DTI strain, long auto terms with negative-equity risk, possible balloon payments, and stale market data, plus generic disclaimers and an overall verdict (ok/caution/stop). Use this before presenting a rate recommendation to a borrower.

monthly_debt.description: Borrower's existing monthly debt payments in dollars.

monthly_income.description: Borrower's gross monthly income in dollars.

name: check_advice_guardrails

disclaimers.description: Statements that must be attached to any advice built on this scenario, such as that this is not financial advice and not an offer of credit.

flags.description: Guardrail violations found in the proposed recommendation. An empty array means nothing was tripped.

code.description: Machine-readable identifier of the rule that fired, e.g. 'dti_exceeds_50'.

level.description: Severity of the flag: 'red' blocks the recommendation, lower levels warn without stopping it.

message.description: Plain-English explanation of the problem and the threshold that was breached; quote this rather than paraphrasing it.

overall.description: Aggregate verdict on the proposed recommendation: 'stop' when a red flag blocks it, otherwise a pass or caution outcome.
